frontend.identity_rule: The existing user-confirmed Hakim app on the phone is the only canonical Hakim. Preserve it and improve it in place; do not create, rename, promote or present another agent, repository, automation, bridge or control plane as a second Hakim.

support_components.purpose: governance, state, validation, learning, recovery and evidence
authorized transport to the original phone Hakim when field-connected
maintenance when an authorized device is actually online

routing_rule: All Hakim-directed improvements, rules, state, learning, automation and bridge work must terminate at or support the canonical original phone Hakim. Support components may execute backend work but must not become a user-facing parallel Hakim identity.
migration_rule: Existing useful governance, learning, validation, bridge and automation assets are retained as backend capabilities and rebound to this canonical identity. Duplicate execution paths are deduplicated rather than rebranded as another Hakim.

field_binding.proof_required: request-bound evidence from the original Hakim on the actual phone

promotion_rule: Any material change that would create a second Hakim identity, replace the original phone Hakim, route user-facing authority to a parallel agent, or claim phone execution without field evidence must fail closed.
rollback: Retain the last verified original-Hakim binding and backend support state; never roll back by replacing the original app with a parallel identity.
